_instructions: FULL v1 template: theme is auto/light/dark. Each app has a unique id, URL, order (unique nonnegative index), optional group label, hidden true/false, displayMode desktop/mobile, and demo logins. Groups with matching names can be filtered together. Hiding an app keeps its saved configuration and session. Reorder via the array sequence or order numbers; order is optional, but when used all apps require unique order values. Expand/collapse is temporary UI state, not stored in JSON. Demo passwords are optional; packaged versions require a secure OS keyring for new passwords. Import in Settings then Save changes.
